documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PETG Translucent
Bambu PETG Translucent Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127G01
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PETG Translucent
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 29 ± 3 MPa, elongation 5.2 ± 0.9 %, bending modulus 1520 ± 110 MPa, bending strength 55 ± 4 MPa, impact 7.2 ± 1.8 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT are raw-material properties (ISO 1183, DSC, ISO 306, ISO 75) and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows. The registry has no *.printed / *.material key pair, so the split is by key group and test_condition.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1420 ± 160 MPa, Z 1230 ± 140 MPa), melt index (11.7 ± 1.5 g/10 min at 230 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), heat deflection temperature 74 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.30% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), nozzle size (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (30 - 60 mm/s), chamber temperature (35 - 50 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), annealing of prints (not recommended; if done, 60 to 70 °C for 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (35 - 50 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability, not a filament print setting.

material.spool_type is not written: the store page has no spool bullet for this product, and the TDS gives the spool material (ABS) and size, not a spool type name. It is not marked not_published either, since the TDS does describe the spool.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PETG Translucent", model "G01-xx", CLP "Not classified", no PBT/vPvB substance or endocrine disruptor, and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 230 - 270 °C vs material-table wiki 230 - 260 ℃ ±10 °C); bed temperature (TDS 65 - 75 °C vs material-table wiki 60 - 80 ℃); 0.2 mm nozzle (TDS lists it under Nozzle Size; the store FAQ, the material-table wiki and the PETG wiki exclude it). The product TDS values are kept for the spec keys; the 0.2 mm relation follows the three sources that exclude it.

AMS drying (no key; oven values are stored): the material-table wiki gives 65 ℃ for 12 h in the AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT, the PETG wiki 65 °C, 8 h (AMS HT / AMS 2 Pro), the drying wiki (generic PETG row) 65 °C, 12 h. The material-table wiki also says drying before use is "Required" and desiccant protection during use is "Required" for PETG HF / PETG Translucent; the store FAQ says the filament "must be dried before use".

Build plate guidance: the TDS lists glue as the surface preparation and the material-table wiki recommends glue stick or liquid glue; this is a recommendation, not a stated requirement, so no requires relation is written. The Bambu Cool Plate / PLA Plate is "Not recommended" (material-table wiki), not "not compatible", so no relation is written for it either.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Robust Endurance", "Durable, Weather-Resistant, and Long-Lasting", "exceptional impact resistance", "waterproof", "resilience under prolonged exposure to UV", "Excellent light transmittance" and "Minimal Warping" are not stored as values.

Hex: 8 of the 9 store colours have exactly one hex cell, matched by the colour name after the table's "Translucent " prefix, without the code in parentheses. "Clear (32101)" has no hex in the official table, so none is written (no hex is invented). The store page prose still says "8 vibrant colors" while its Colour group lists 9 values.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/45e0bfd4faf34c3db8a0f3a1ed264727.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.

The store page also links the wiki pages https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/knowledge-sharing/transparent-petg ("Printing tips for transparent PETG") and https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool, which were not cached and not read.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store FAQ (5.Safety Tips) and the PETG wiki say the filament is not food-grade / not food-contact grade; no registry key holds this.
